source.spec: October 2026 audit proposal #3 (metric-contracts), listed in the 2026-11-10 skill inventory; built on request 2026-11-26. dbt artifact shapes taken from semantic_manifest.json and manifest.json written by dbt-core 1.12.7 (dbt-duckdb 1.11.1), legacy and 1.12 YAML spec
source.build_pattern: Three deterministic stdlib scripts with a shared loader over dbt's semantic_manifest.json or a plain contract JSON: 13-rule definition linter, base-vs-head diff with transitive impact, rename mapping and a version-bump gate, and a two-source reconciler that classifies the gap pattern; typed exit codes, no warehouse access
